$comment: Mission templates. Contract: docs/GDD.md 'Missions and parties' (Phase 10). Types: kill (count, optional archetype), scout (poi = zone id, completes on entering its mast-discovery radius), fetch (item + count, turn-in at the board consumes them), bounty (the limited one -- posted by the bounty scheduler, never offered at the board; 'archetype' names the NPC it spawns). Rewards are credits through the normal wallet. board=true is offered by the dispatcher; the quartermaster offers starter=true ones too.

missions.name: Thin the herd
missions.text: Hostiles at the camp and the outpost are getting bold. Put five down.

missions.name: Counter-battery
missions.text: The ranged ones first. Kill three gunners.

missions.name: Eyes on the outpost
missions.text: Get close enough to the scrapyard outpost to read its mast.

missions.name: Eyes on the camp
missions.text: Confirm the encampment is where we think it is.

missions.name: Cell salvage
missions.text: Bring back thirty energy cells scavenged from hostile drops.

missions.name: PRIORITY: warlord sighted
missions.text: A warlord is rallying the scrap gangs. One party takes the contract; end them.
